Hey — we need today's model routing scorecard filled out before Friday's ops review. The raw evaluation numbers from our harness are sitting in the workspace under `data/raw_evals/` (the JSON file for 2025-07-08). You'll also want to check the platform config in `config/` for any vendor restrictions currently in effect.

Please produce the daily scorecard as a Markdown file named `daily_scorecard_2025-07-08.md`. It should cover all seven routing categories, show each model's performance breakdown, the computed composite scores, which model ranks first on raw numbers versus which one we're actually routing to today, and a confidence rating for each routing decision.

Make sure the vendor policy we have in place right now is correctly reflected in the routing column — not just the raw rankings.
